original_test_intent: Retrieve Device SDR records in-band using correct reservation, record-ID, offset and length semantics, then validate traversal and decode each target standard/OEM sensor record without mutation.
original_method: Preserve Sensor/Event 0x04/0x21 and original fields. Treat zero reservation bytes as acceptable only where the approved target schema explicitly permits the full-record request; otherwise bind a valid same-session reservation.
manual_activity: Owner validates device/LUN, reservation policy, standard/OEM decoders and expected record population once; bounded repository reads need no per-run confirmation.
required_inputs: Reservation requirements for full and partial reads
Standard and vendor-OEM Device SDR schemas
safety_requirements: Never reuse stale or cross-session reservation
agent_execution_scope: Issue bounded 0x04/0x21 request with validated fields
Capture completion, next ID and raw record
Validate header/type/length then decode standard/OEM data
Continue only through returned next IDs within a hard record bound
Return redacted inventory and non-mutation audit

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek is too restrictive because stock `ipmitool raw` can express the supplied field sequence; however, Master zero reservation, placeholder Record ID and command-success Criteria are not enough for safe validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected `ipmitool raw 0x04 0x21 <reservation-lsb> <reservation-msb> <record-lsb> <record-msb> <offset> <count>` with schema-approved byte order, reservation and bounded count; follow returned next IDs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Netfn/cmd, the original zero-reservation/full-read vector, attended time 10 and machine time 5 remain visible; any corrected reservation is documented as conditional target behavior.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Establish target/LUN and population stability, use the required session reservation, traverse returned IDs and decode every bounded response with record-change and loop protection.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds conditional reservation correctness and deterministic record parsing in the Review layer while preserving Master source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A high-level sensor/SDR list is supplemental only unless it proves the same raw record IDs, request fields, next-ID chain and payload semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong byte order or stale reservation can select the wrong record; unsupported OEM decoders can silently misstate sensor identity or thresholds; topology data may be sensitive.

project_override_considerations: A vendor/Redfish inventory path is equivalent only for content coverage when record identity and all required fields map deterministically. It does not automatically validate raw 0x04/0x21 behavior.
expected_evidence: Returned next-record chain with loop/end proof
Raw header/type/length plus decoded standard/OEM fields

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master hard-codes a zero reservation while leaving Record ID open, clears logs and accepts only command success. DeepSeek says the request is not expressible. Review preserves the raw vector, flags reservation conditionality and defines traversal/parser acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and field roles are identifiable. Device/LUN, reservation rule, record baseline and OEM schema are supplyable project inputs; unsupported records can be reported without mutation.

review_improvement: Restores executable raw coverage, prevents stale-token and guessed-ID reads, and makes next-ID traversal, record structure and OEM decoding auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Device SDR repository is traversed by protocol-returned record identifiers, not assumed numeric adjacency. Correctness therefore depends on request byte order, reservation lifetime, next-ID continuity and each record's declared length/type. With bounded reads and pinned decoders this is deterministic and safely automatable.
